item.title: Cuba unveils new details in fatal US boat shooting and says a 2nd boat on mission failed
item.description: Top officials with Cuba's Ministry of the Interior have unveiled for the first time the items they said were aboard a Florida-flagged speedboat that opened fire against troops in waters off the island's north coast this week, with soldiers responding and killing four suspects.

item.title: Abiy's vision of Ethiopia includes a seaport in Eritrea. Some see a looming conflict
item.description: Ethiopia's prime minister sees himself as a renaissance man trying to reimagine the old greatness of his country.

item.title: Knicks' Jalen Brunson leads balanced scoring attack in rout of Bucks
item.description: Jalen Brunson scored 27 points, OG Anunoby added 24, Karl-Anthony Towns had 17 points and 13 rebounds and Landry Shamet added 15 points.

item.title: Pistons outlast short-handed Cavaliers 122-119 in OT after blaring horn delay
item.description: Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119 on Friday night in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.

item.title: Holy Trinity boys basketball's Tristan Thomas scores 26 points, propels Titans to NSCHSAA title
item.description: The Titans win their first league title since 2022 in a game they led by 20 in the fourth quarter.

item.title: No. 3 Michigan claims Big Ten regular-season title with an 84-70 win over No. 10 Illinois
item.description: Morez Johnson Jr. had 19 points and 11 rebounds against his former team as No. 3 Michigan defeated No. 10 Illinois 84-70 and clinched the Big Ten regular-season title.

item.title: Soldiers on the streets. What's behind South Africa's plan to deploy army in high-crime areas
item.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says he will deploy the army to high crime areas to help police in this country that has some of the highest violent crime rates in the world.

item.title: Celtics post one of NBA's best offensive performances as they await Jayson Tatum's possible return
item.description: The Celtics have been one of the NBA's hottest teams since returning from the All-Star break.

item.title: Mammoth beat Minnesota 5-2 to end the Wild's winning streak at 6
item.description: Lawson Crouse scored twice, U.S. Olympian Clayton Keller had a goal and two assists and the Utah Mammoth beat Minnesota 5-2 on Friday night to end the Wild's winning streak at six games.

item.title: Cam Spencer sparks a short-handed Grizzlies rout of the Mavericks, 124-105
item.description: Cam Spencer scored 25 points off the bench and Olivier-Maxence Prosper had 16 points and 10 rebounds to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 124-105 victory over the Dallas Mavericks.
